title: La ruta
goal: Take a bus without ending up somewhere else
culture: The cobrador hangs out of the door shouting the destination and he is the one you pay, not the driver. There are no printed stops: you tell him where you are getting off and he remembers, and you shout before you get there or you see the next town.

beats.good: Ask from the pavement, before you get on. He is shouting a destination and so is the bus in front of him, which is going somewhere else.

beats.es: ¡Sí, Masaya! Súbase, súbase, ya nos vamos.
beats.objective: Tell him where to drop you
beats.good: Me deja en... names your stop. There is no bell and no list — you tell him once and he keeps it in his head along with everybody else’s.

beats.objective: Ask where the stop actually is
beats.good: La parada is wherever people are standing. Asking is faster than looking for a sign, because there is no sign.

beats.objective: Call out that you are getting off
beats.good: Shout it, and shout it early. Ya voy bajando is the difference between your stop and a long walk back from the next one.
